\chapter{Return to One Familiar Three-Field Repair}
\label{ch:pa-form-repair-r4}
\hlchaptermodality{175}

\begin{chapteropening}
\textbf{By the end of this chapter:} \emph{I can compare a fictional three-field form with its familiar card and correct one different part without rewriting the correct lines.}

Make one supported correction and then one brief delayed correction on familiar fictional form values, outside scored A1 mock credit.
\end{chapteropening}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\pa{ਕ} / \pa{ਖ} (one familiar …)}{ਕ / ਖ (one familiar …)}]{One old form, one small correction}

\label{lesson:PA-R175-form-repair-again}



\begin{quote}
Use only these old fictional cards, never your own details. \textbf{\pa{ਕ}} chooses A: age \textbf{\pa{੧੫}}, phone \textbf{\pa{੦੧੨} \pa{੨੫੧}}, date \textbf{\pa{੧੫}/\pa{੦੧}/\pa{੨੦੨੫}}. \textbf{\pa{ਖ}} chooses B: age \textbf{\pa{੨੫}}, phone \textbf{\pa{੦੨੫} \pa{੧੨੫}}, date \textbf{\pa{੨੫}/\pa{੦੨}/\pa{੨੦੨੫}}. Keep the bank visible. Check the card first, then the three labels and values one line at a time. This gentle return is not a scored A1 mock.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
The card is \textbf{\pa{ਖ}}. In this printed form, the age and date already match B; the phone's last two digits do not. Point to the single different line. Copy only its correction, \textbf{\pa{ਫ਼ੋਨ}: \pa{੦੨੫} \pa{੧੨੫}}, beside the form. Do not erase or rewrite the two correct lines.

\begin{quote}
\pa{ਉਮਰ}: \pa{੨੫}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\pa{ਫ਼ੋਨ}: \pa{੦੨੫} \pa{੧੫੨}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\pa{ਤਾਰੀਖ਼}: \pa{੨੫}/\pa{੦੨}/\pa{੨੦੨੫}
\end{quote}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Cover the bank and the guided correction. The card is now \textbf{\pa{ਕ}}. Compare the printed three-field form below with the values you remember. Find the one different line and write its repaired version on a fresh line without looking back. Leave the two matching lines alone.

\begin{quote}
\pa{ਉਮਰ}: \pa{੧੫}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\pa{ਫ਼ੋਨ}: \pa{੦੧੨} \pa{੨੫੧}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\pa{ਤਾਰੀਖ਼}: \pa{੧੫}/\pa{੦੧੨੦੨੫}
\end{quote}

Now uncover the bank and check your repair: \textbf{\pa{ਤਾਰੀਖ਼}: \pa{੧੫}/\pa{੦੧}/\pa{੨੦੨੫}}. The only change was the missing slash; every digit, age, and phone stays the same. This is a brief independent correction within a supported practice session, not an independent timed task, paper scoring, or human A1 validation.
\end{tcolorbox}
